expectations.text: PRD/SPEC 固化人工确认与人工降级
expectations.evidence: PRD-APPROVAL/DEGRADE and SPEC-AI-002/003 make AI draft-only, require explicit agent confirmation, and preserve manual chat when AI fails.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖流式、检索、越权和重复发送异常
expectations.evidence: chat.md, ai-assist.md and knowledge.md contain scenarios for stream interruption, missing/withdrawn knowledge, cross-tenant denial and idempotent duplicate send.

expectations.text: 架构分别论证中间件并给出移除条件
expectations.evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md separately evaluates realtime, Redis/cache, queue and model provider; it defers Redis/broker and gives measurable introduce/revisit/exit conditions.

expectations.text: 安全文档覆盖 AI 数据和提示注入风险
expectations.evidence: SECURITY.md requires no provider training, retrieval ACLs, prompt-injection isolation, no model tool permissions and provider/DPA review.

expectations.text: 部署门禁监控性能、并发、质量、成本和降级
expectations.evidence: DEPLOY.md monitors first-token P95, 3000/4500 connections, AI quality/release evaluation, ¥50k budget and manual-mode fault injection; production remains blocked pending SLO/RTO/RPO.

needs_review: Region, DPA, availability SLO and recovery objectives remain production blockers.

eval_feedback.overall: The eval strongly exercises conditional AI and middleware reasoning.
